name: xAI
billing: The xAI quickstart requires API credits. Check your team’s balance, model access and spend limits in the console.

steps.title: Select your API team
steps.body: Create an account or sign in to the xAI API Console and choose the team that should be billed.

steps.title: Add API credits
steps.body: Add API credits and review the team’s spending limits.

steps.title: Create an API key
steps.body: Open API keys, create a key with access to your chosen model, and store it privately in your local application environment.
